details.description: GLM-4.5-Air is a smaller, open-weight Mixture-of-Experts sibling of GLM-4.5 from Z.ai (Zhipu AI), with 106 billion total parameters and 12 billion active per forward pass. Like GLM-4.5, it offers a switchable thinking mode for complex reasoning and tool use and a non-thinking mode for immediate replies, unifying reasoning, coding and agentic capabilities at lower compute cost than the full-size model. It is released under the MIT license, permitting commercial use.
advantages: Scores 81.4 on MMLU-Pro, per Z.ai's GLM-4.5-Air model card.
Scores 71.72 on GPQA Diamond, per the model card.
Z.ai reports GLM-4.5-Air surpasses Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3-235B and Claude 4 Opus on reasoning benchmarks, per Z.ai's API documentation.
Supports native, OpenAI-style function calling and tool schemas, per Z.ai's GitHub repository.
disadvantages: Scores lower than the full GLM-4.5 on Z.ai's own aggregate benchmark index (59.8 vs. 63.2 across the same 12 benchmarks), per Z.ai's documentation and GitHub repository.
Text-only model: input and output are both text, per Z.ai's API documentation.
use_cases: Agentic tool-calling and coding tasks at lower compute cost than the full GLM-4.5
Reasoning tasks using the switchable thinking mode

notes: Catalog facts (128000 max input / 96000 max output, text-only) match Z.ai's own API docs exactly. Could not confirm a specific supported-language list on a maker page (only general Chinese/English framing), so languages is left empty per the brief's guidance. Verify pass: all benchmark figures (MMLU-Pro 81.4, GPQA Diamond 71.72, HLE 8.12, the 59.8-vs-63.2 aggregate comparison, and the Gemini 2.5 Flash/Qwen3-235B/Claude 4 Opus reasoning-benchmark claim) were confirmed verbatim on the cited pages. Z.ai's GitHub README also lists GLM-4.6 and GLM-4.7 as newer generations in the same model family; no maker page labels GLM-4.5-Air itself deprecated or legacy, and it remains listed on Z.ai's current pricing page.
